resources.string: Each background has its own layout and animation • the colours are the theme\'s
The Milky Way, twinkling and shooting stars • the big cards layout
Floating lights, a moving trading grid and a chart line • the compact table layout

Pick one of two in Menu → Background — each has its own layout and its own animation: Galaxy, the Milky Way (twinkling and shooting stars, a flight towards the galaxy) with the big cards layout, and Space Glass, floating lights, a moving trading grid and a chart line with the compact table (a slim header, one line a stock, a floating bar below). Pick the colours in Menu → Theme: any theme goes on either background, and its colours reach the background too. Turning off the sky\'s animation in Settings holds the background still.
